episodes.title: Christian sect quizzed over electioneering
episodes.description:
The role of a secretive Christian sect in political campaigning in Australia is under the microscope today.

In an appearance before a parliamentary inquiry, the head of the Plymouth Brethren Christian Church rejecting assertions his organisation attempted to influence the outcome of the 2025 federal election.

It comes as media reports published today, suggest church elders paid far right influencers to disrupt Labor campaign events last year.
More Information

Featured:

Lloyd Grimshaw, Plymouth Brethren Christian Church
